description: Save files the page builds itself, with no browser download and no "Save as" dialog: blob and data URL links (a[download]), window.showSaveFilePicker writes, and downloads the page starts (cancelled at once, bytes fetched again with the browser cookies). arm with save_dir, then click Export/Download, then wait: it returns the saved paths. A file with a URL: http_request save_to instead. Names are cleaned, existing files never overwritten, size capped by max_mb.

action.description: arm before the click; wait returns what arrived and stays armed; disarm restores the page

max_mb.description: arm: per-file cap in MB (default 100, max 200); a bigger file is skipped

save_dir.description: arm: absolute directory for the files; created if missing

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

timeout.description: wait: max ms for the first file

name: capture_downloads
